in_sanskrit.name: अविनाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which is not to be destroyed, imperishable

in_hindi.name: अविनाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: That which is not destroyed, imperishable

in_marathi.name: Avinash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Absence of Sins
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avinash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avinash translates to 'absence of sins' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'avinā' (without) and 'nāsh' (sins). In Hindu mythology, Avinash is considered a synonym for Moksha, or liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

vedic_reference.note: The name Avinash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'अविनाश' (Avinaash) which means 'that which is not to be destroyed, imperishable'. It is also the name of the Hindu deity Shiva, who is often referred to as 'अविनाशकर' (Avinashkar), the lord of Avinaash, the imperishable.
